title: Heleonix configuration
description: Shared by builds (the bundler plugins), editors (the language server) and tooling. The nearest hx.config.json at or above a package governs it; relative paths resolve against the file declaring them.

extends.markdownDescription: A configuration to build on: a path (`../../hx.config.json`, or a folder holding one) or a file of an installed package (`@acme/config/hx.config.json`). This file's settings win key by key; `diagnostics.severity` merges code by code.

include.markdownDescription: The directories holding the sources to compile (default: this file's directory). Declare it in each package's own configuration - a plugin's `include` option wins over it.

exclude.markdownDescription: Folder names skipped wherever they occur (`fixtures`), or paths skipped with everything below them (`./src/legacy`). Replaces the default `["node_modules"]`.

dimensions.markdownDescription: The dimensions sources are named under (`Buttons.en-US.hxd`): a path to a dimensions file (`./hx.dimensions.json`), or the definitions themselves. Files with a segment outside them are not compiled.

typescript.markdownDescription: Where editors find the TypeScript classes (converters, actions, style qualifiers, programmatic components) - read from the configuration governing a workspace folder.

projects.markdownDescription: `tsconfig` files, folders holding one, or glob patterns naming the projects to read; their `references` are followed. Default: `["**/tsconfig.json"]`.

exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of TypeScript files left out of discovery (test fixtures). Builds apply it to the classes their `hx.meta.json` describes.

linkedPackages.markdownDescription: Also read dependencies linked in from outside the workspace folders - for opening one app of a monorepo alone.

severity.markdownDescription: Levels by diagnostic code, replacing each diagnostic's own in builds and editors alike: builds fail on `error` and report `warning`; `information` and `hint` show in editors only; `off` silences a diagnostic everywhere.

failOnWarnings.markdownDescription: Whether builds fail on warnings too. A plugin's `validate.failOnWarnings` option wins over it.
